description: This file provides extension methods for configuring an Orleans silo to use AWS DynamoDB as grain storage, including default and named storage configurations with optional settings.

classes.name: DynamoDBGrainStorageSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Static class containing extension methods to configure DynamoDB as grain storage for Orleans silos.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, with options provided via an Action.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specific name, options provided via an Action.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorageAsDefault (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage as the default grain storage, with options provided via an OptionsBuilder.

methods.name: AddDynamoDBGrainStorage (overload)
methods.description: Configures the silo to use AWS DynamoDB storage with a specific name, options provided via an OptionsBuilder.
